---
title: "Convert Motif Format"
output: html_document
date: "2025-09-13"
params: 
  outDir: "data/Motifs"
  motifModelsPath: "combinations.tsv"
  threads: 16
---

```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(universalmotif)
```

```{r, convert motifs}
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
motifModels <- readRDS(file.path("../..", params$motifModelsPath))
outDir <- file.path("../..", params$outDir)

for(tf in names(motifModels)){
  outPath <- file.path(outDir, paste0(tf, ".jaspar"))
  write_jaspar(motifModels[[tf]], file=outPath, overwrite=TRUE) 
}
```

```{r, sessionInfo}
sessionInfo()
```
